fieldValues.title: 2. Make meaning: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: Work starts from meaning: a problem in a domain, held by a persona, in words that trace back to the experience they came from.

What we have tried: The method package (problems, personas, domains, clusters, remedies); the Suggestions, Affirmed and Set aside layers; problem scouts and the similar check; domain axes on the trigram (clerk#158); narrative explorations as the source; the products repository's earlier problem template with 'felt tension' and a domain tension map.

Problems recorded here: SP-101, SP-102, SP-105, SP-73, SP-94, SP-98, SP-72.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 1, Explore and commit to a statement: too far toward Commit to a statement. The method was designed before there were tools to practise it, and affirming its records one at a time is harder than writing them (SP-101, SP-102).
- Line 2, Many readings and one definition: too far toward Many readings. SP-62, SP-63, SP-67 and others exist twice under one id; agents create records where one already holds the meaning (SP-105).
- Line 3, The owner's words and the method's types: too far toward The method's types. Types and relations (axes, poles, clusters, care modes) were added ahead of practice; clusters still cannot be compared side by side (SP-73).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- The three tensions are a first pass: none has its four 2×2 cases or the cube filled yet (handbook, A domain's axes, steps 3 and 4).
- Is each tension orthogonal to the other two in this stage, and which pole is yang here: does it flip from the parent domain?
fieldValues.next_action: Fill the 2×2 cases from the stage's own history; then name the remedy that moves us back out of each shadow.
